prompt: What percentage of the global mobile population is covered by 2G networks in 2024, according to the International Telecommunication Union (ITU)?
answer: According to the ITU, **approximately 99% of the world’s population was covered by at least a 2G mobile network in 2024**. This measures network availability, not actual mobile-phone use or subscriptions.
